description: This Java class `ClientAttributeIncentiveCalculation` extends `AttributeIncentiveCalculation` and calculates incentives based on client attributes such as gender, age, client type, and classification. It determines whether to apply incentives based on specified conditions and types, and adjusts interest accordingly.

classes.name: ClientAttributeIncentiveCalculation
classes.description: A class responsible for calculating interest incentives based on client attributes such as gender, age, client type, and classification.

methods.name: calculateIncentive
methods.description: Calculates the incentive-interest adjustment based on client attributes and incentive conditions.
